title: GoPro: Wingsuit Flight Through 2 Meter Cave - Uli Emanuele
summary: A short GoPro film of Uli Emanuele's wingsuit BASE jump through a roughly 2 meter wide cave opening, after three years of preparation. It follows his climb to the exit point and the flight itself, shot on a HERO2 camera.
why: HN commenters cite it as a striking example of humans doing extremely dangerous, precise things for fun.

quote.text: Constant pushing of the envelope in a incredibly dangerous sport.
